question: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn’t in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser.
sql:
WITH purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
),
pageview_counts AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, COUNT(*) as pageviews
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
all_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
user_pageviews AS (
  SELECT 
    au.user_pseudo_id,
    COALESCE(pv.pageviews, 0) as pageviews,
    CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_purchaser
  FROM all_users au
  LEFT JOIN pageview_counts pv ON au.user_pseudo_id = pv.user_pseudo_id
  LEFT JOIN purchasers p ON au.user_pseudo_id = p.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 1 THEN pageviews END) as avg_purchaser_pageviews,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 0 THEN pageviews END) as avg_non_purchaser_pageviews,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 1 THEN pageviews END) - AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 0 THEN pageviews END) as avg_difference
FROM user_pageviews
